decisions.reason: As the flagship platform with several models, D carries heavy investment and visible public commitment and is central to the firm's announced direction, so management will persist with it.

The mobile field data capture software sits close to the core offer, has had its own page, and builds on sunk development effort, so management will keep it, though it is less protected than the flagship.

The search extension was publicly updated to version 1.6.0, showing continued investment and fit with the core web-map platform, so management will keep maintaining it even though similar small plugins were dropped earlier.
